name: Falling Maple Leaves
description: Red maple leaves falling over the video, spinning down on the wind.

params.name: mode
params.description: Motion: 0 tumble (spin round, carried by the wind), 1 pendulum swing, 2 spiral, 3 no swing (wind still drifts)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of leaf slots; strong wind carries part of them outside the frame

params.name: speed
params.description: Fall speed, frame heights per second

params.name: wind
params.description: Sideways drift, frame heights per second (negative blows left)

params.name: size
params.description: Smallest and largest leaf, in frame heights

params.name: offset
params.description: Seconds added to the time (e.g. to keep the leaves in place after -ss)
